summary: Mana-stacker Mnemonic Ring: fractured mana cost efficiency (anchor), T1 flat mana, % mana essence, T2 cast speed, a T1 resistance and desecrated mana regeneration.
benchmarkReason: Single lucky run: T2 cast speed on the first catalysed slam ('we got pretty lucky', 6:44-7:00), T1 max mana on the second ('we hit the 10%', 9:06-9:11), Essence of the Mind 50/50 won (9:56-9:59). Anchor: 'this ring cost me 200 divs ... a little less than that. Like 160 divs or 170' (12:29-12:42), the same run's total. It includes ~90 div of MCE bases and fracture attempts ('we spent 90 divs trying to hit this', 3:46-3:52) that the planner replaces with its own fracture phase, so a pass here is weak evidence.

steps: Buy Mnemonic Rings with a perfectly rolled mana cost efficiency prefix, 3 prefixes and 1 suffix, 10 div each

Dextral Crystallisation + Essence of the Abyss + Collarbone, Fracturing Orb (8 div): missed, missed, hit on the 3rd base ('we spent 90 divs trying to hit this'). Not costed: mana cost efficiency is not a planner mod (the planner sees a fractured non-target anchor)
Annul down, Chaos spam for a T1 suffix ('we spent like 10 divs on this'; ~110 chaos at the ~11 chaos per div Hax states in qATcKacI83o 3:01-3:04, derived)
Sinistral Exaltation + Exalt, Sinistral Crystallisation + Essence of the Breach; speed catalysts to 40%

Dextral Necromancy + Collarbone + Echoes reveals a blocker (strength); Catalysing + Perfect Exalt: T2 cast speed (he forgot the Dextral Exaltation and says to use it, 6:48-6:58; costed as recommended)
Neural catalysts to 40%, Catalysing + Perfect Exalt hit T1 rarity (miss); re-quality, Sinistral Annulment, Catalysing + Perfect Exalt: T1 max mana
Omen of Whittling + Chaos removes the quality mod (he forgot to re-quality first); Perfect Essence of the Mind 50/50 won
Omen of Light + Annul once (10:57-11:05), Ancient Collarbone + Echoes reroll (11:29-11:49): took mana regeneration (59%); Divine + Orb of the Blessed not costed
